requirements.title: Substituted cases record their owner and claim limits

properties.statement: A substituted case is accepted with a recorded owner and forbidden claims, and rejected without them.
properties.oracle: A complete substituted case record, and the same record without the owner and claim fields.

properties.statement: A case that records its migration is reported as a gap, keeps readiness incomplete, and cannot pass with an empty reason.
properties.oracle: A clean git fixture whose substituted case records claims_pending, and the same case with an empty reason.

properties.statement: Unsubstituted and planned-undecided cases keep their previous behavior.
properties.oracle: The default fixture case and an implemented undecided case.

cases.setup: Set the fixture's first case to an approved substitution carrying owner_replaced, forbidden_claims and allowed_proof, then build the graph.
cases.observable: The graph builds and reports no substitution gap.
cases.red_expectation: A validator that demanded a field the record already has would reject a complete case.
cases.green_expectation: The complete substituted case validates with an empty gap list.

substitution.note: The temporary fixture repository is controlled input to the real validator.

cases.distinct_reason: Proves the completed shape is accepted rather than unconditionally rejected.

cases.setup: Set the same case to an approved substitution with neither owner_replaced nor forbidden_claims and build the graph.
cases.observable: The validator rejects the case and names both missing fields.
cases.red_expectation: A validator that accepted the bare classification would report no error.
cases.green_expectation: The rejection message names owner_replaced and forbidden_claims.

substitution.note: The incomplete record is controlled invalid input.

cases.distinct_reason: Restores the retired manifests' per-case claim discipline as a hard rejection.

cases.setup: Record claims_pending with a migration reason on the substituted case, commit a clean git fixture, and run the complete selection with require_clean.
cases.observable: The gap is listed in the summary and the run is incomplete with a substitution_gap case status.
cases.red_expectation: A validator that hid the pending gap would report a passing readiness run.
cases.green_expectation: Readiness stays incomplete while the recorded gap exists.

substitution.note: The git fixture is a controlled local repository.

cases.distinct_reason: Provides the documented migration route without letting it claim readiness.

cases.setup: Record claims_pending as whitespace on the substituted case and build the graph.
cases.red_expectation: A validator that accepted an empty migration reason would let the gap disappear silently.

substitution.note: The empty reason is controlled invalid input.

cases.distinct_reason: Closes the loophole an empty migration reason would open.

cases.setup: Build the default fixture, whose cases classify themselves as NO_TEST_DOUBLE.
cases.red_expectation: A validator that demanded claim limits from unsubstituted cases would block every existing graph.
cases.green_expectation: The unsubstituted fixture reports an empty gap list.
cases.distinct_reason: Preserves every existing NO_TEST_DOUBLE graph unchanged.

cases.setup: Set an implemented case to UNDECIDED and build the graph.
cases.observable: The existing implemented-undecided rejection still fires.
cases.red_expectation: A validator that skipped the undecided rule would accept an unresolved boundary.
cases.green_expectation: The undecided implemented case is rejected.
cases.distinct_reason: Proves the new rule did not replace the existing boundary rule.
